title: Locale-aware quantization routing and smoke harness for latency-sensitive rerank
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current reranking endpoint shows inconsistent tail latency and quality regressions across non-English locales when a single quantized cross-encoder variant is served globally. Some locales (e.g., ja, ko, pt-BR) experience 95th percentile latency spikes under peak load, and the quality delta versus the float baseline is uneven across languages.

Goal: Deliver a routing and model-selection layer that can: (1) select per-locale quantization profiles and kernel variants at request time, (2) route to a lightweight bi-encoder fallback under tight SLO pressure, and (3) provide a deterministic smoke/regression harness that validates quality parity and latency budgets across a stratified set of locales before rollout. The work should enable staged rollouts with automatic rollback on quality regressions or SLO violation and integrate with the existing rollout dashboard and alerting.

Scope: Implement a shard-aware routing policy that considers region, locale, and current GPU queue latency; add two new quantization profiles (int8/gtq and mixed-bf16), expose routing config in the model catalog, build a reproducible smoke harness with locale-stratified testcases and stable seeds, and add lightweight canary metrics to the console for per-locale P50/P95/P99 latency and pairwise NDCG/Recall deltas.

Out of scope: Full model retraining or creating new cross-encoder architectures. This ticket focuses on selection, routing, quant profiles, and validation harness for upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Routing: Traffic can be routed by locale->quant-profile->model-variant and routing decisions are logged for each request (region, locale, chosen variant, reason).

SLOs: For target locales (en, es, fr, pt-BR, ja, ko), P95 latency for rerank under standard 95% load <= 220ms on production-like hardware for the chosen variant or automatic fallback to lightweight bi-encoder is triggered.
Quality: The smoke harness shows no more than 0.7% average NDCG drop vs float baseline per locale (with a per-locale fail flag if drop > 1.5%).
Regression harness: End-to-end smoke run (1000 queries stratified by locale) is reproducible and stored; runs are integrated into the pre-rollout checklist and can be executed in CI.
Rollout: Canary rollout can be limited to 5% of requests per locale with automatic rollback on either latency SLO breach or quality fail thresholds.
Observability: Console shows per-locale latency percentiles and pairwise quality deltas; routing decisions surface in traces for investigation.

comments: 2025-01-10 Asha: Created ticket after postmortem discussion about locale latency spikes. Initial hypothesis is quant kernel sensitivity + uneven KV cache warmup for long-tail tokenization patterns.

2025-01-12 Marco: Architecture sketch uploaded to Confluence; proposing a lightweight router that checks request.locale -> consults a small policy table -> evaluates runtime queue depth before pinning to variant. Added note to consider GPU fragment placement for private deployments.

2025-01-15 Lin: Microbenchmarks show mixed-bf16 preserves quality for ja/ko with ~12% higher latency vs int8/gtq at batch sizes 1-4; int8/gtq shows best cost but larger quality variance for zh/ja when using default tokenizer. Need per-locale tokenization normalization experiments.

2025-01-20 Riley: Prototype router implemented in staging proxy; basic routing by locale works. Observed that when queue depth > 8, fallback is necessary to keep P95 under 220ms. Instrumentation added to trace routing reason codes.

2025-01-28 Samir: Implemented bi-encoder fallback path with hedging delay 30ms; on staging under synthetic load, fallback reduces tail latency by ~30% at ~5% quality loss on average. Creating config knob to tune hedging delay and fallback threshold.

2025-01-30 Asha: Smoke harness v0 added to CI: 1k queries stratified across 6 locales with seeded sampling. Early runs show pt-BR still has a 1.2% NDCG drop under int8 profile — flagged for manual review. Added reference dataset link.

2025-02-01 Marco: Design review feedback: require explicit telemetry for per-locale model health and add a conservative rollout gating policy. Also requested adding a 'dry-run' router mode that logs decisions without affecting production traffic for 48 hours.

2025-02-02 Lin: Bench PR open: github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/pull/4123 — includes quant kernels and benchmark results. Planning to land after perf-run across EU/US staging and adding tokenization normalization patch.
